interpretation: Stock SimulationApp child exited with SIGSEGV during viewport initialization; post-exit NVML cleanup was incorrectly labeled as unresolved ownership by the monitor.
reasoning: ON/OFF/ON calibration verified the same child NVML PID before stock startup.
The preceding monitor sample contains the live child with its expected start ticks and accepted NVML alias.
Final monitor sample has zero live owned processes while NVML still reports only that already-bound PID, with declining memory.

The launcher removes aliases when the child is no longer live, then enters its ownership guard. Its cleanup only signals live owned processes, so this final zero-live-process guard cannot account for the preceding SIGSEGV.
The preserved vendor log records Fatal Python error: Segmentation fault during SimulationApp._wait_for_viewport.
scope_limitation: Standard SimulationApp with explicitly precreated GPU4 primary CUDA context for namespace identity calibration; no native RoboDojo environment.
